newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures firm amid thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures firm amid thin trade.

text.p: Prices for U.S. energy futures firmed in Thursday ACCESS trade, but were seen range-bound overnight amid light interest, traders said.

The overnight market saw NYMEX February heating oil slightly higher, with bids at 72.90 cents, offers at 73.10, following a settlement at 73.05 cents a gallon. Volume stood around 100 lots traded in the front-month and 122 overall.
Crude oil futures were steady from the settle at $26.37 a barrel, amid volumes of 275 lots exchanged in February and 551 lots traded in all months.

Gasoline futures, which skidded lower today on oversupply, picked up overnight, rising 0.27 cents a gallon to 70.75 cents, with traders suspecting local speculators skewing the barrel because of light volume. Around 20 lots traded overall in gasoline.
